title: Bug on data
body: The app is great, however I found a bug that even when you complete all of your habits it doesn’t mark them in the calendar. Hope they fix this. Already pay the fee..

title: Buena aplicación
body: Es muy buena aplicación la verdad si no compras la versión premium queda perfecto no se necesitan todas las opciones que da (si puedes comprarla que bien) Es muy intuitiva non necesita tanta explicación 🥳

title: Aspecto Oscuro
body: Me encanta, solo me gustaría que pusieran nuevos iconos, nuevos colores y la posibilidad de cambiar el aspecto a oscuro.
author: Sickkbooy

title: It’s so good
body: I love this app so so much, in my opinion it’s the best app for starting habits. But i do have to say, I paid for the pro version, everything is fine except for the different pot designs, when you click on any of it the app just crashes. Would be really cool if you fixed that. Really liking this app ❤️

title: Would be nice more habits for trial
author: fabs0000

title: Pretty good, could be better
body:
I like the simplicity of the app, but for the free version instead of limiting it to 5 habits a day, you should limit it to 9 (3 in the morning, 3 in the afternoon and 3 in the evening).
Other than that, it’s a wonderful app!
